description: Two four-way mutable multiples, or one eight-way when only the upper input is used

params.text: Each press silences and restores the one output alongside it
SOFT ramps the level whenever a mute changes on the first four outputs, so audio does not click; HARD switches instantly
SOFT ramps the level when a mute changes on the last four outputs, so audio does not click; HARD switches instantly. With INPUT B unpatched, all eight outputs follow the INPUT A switch

inputs.text: The signal copied to the first four outputs, and to all eight when nothing is patched into INPUT B
The signal copied to the last four outputs; with nothing patched here those outputs take INPUT A instead

outputs.text: A copy of the signal from the input feeding it, silenced while its MUTE button is lit; all channels of a polyphonic cable are passed and muted together
